source: User-supplied Parcel Data Schema, updated 2026-07-09T13:22:32.000Z; selected metadata verified against linked Regrid category pages and https://support.regrid.com/docs/filter-parcels-query-by-field on 2026-10-27

fields.name: parcelnumb
fields.description: Assessor's primary parcel identification number or code

fields.name: parcelnumb_no_formatting
fields.description: Primary parcel ID with spaces and formatting characters removed

fields.name: account_number
fields.description: Assessor or tax collector account identifier

fields.name: tax_id
fields.description: Assessor or tax collector tax identifier

fields.name: usecode
fields.description: Parcel use code; varies by governing municipality

fields.name: usedesc
fields.description: Parcel use description; varies by governing municipality

fields.name: zoning
fields.description: Zoning code used by the governing municipality

fields.name: zoning_code_link
fields.description: Link to the municipality's zoning code

fields.name: zoning_id
fields.description: Zoning area ID for matching to the Regrid zoning product

fields.name: year_built_effective_date
fields.description: Assessor-adjusted year built reflecting condition or major structural changes

fields.name: numunits
fields.description: Number of individual living units, apartments, or condominiums

fields.name: numrooms
fields.description: County-recorded room count for the primary structure

fields.name: parvaltype
fields.description: Type of value reported in parcel value fields

fields.name: taxyear
fields.description: Tax year to which assessor data applies

fields.name: last_ownership_transfer_date
fields.description: Most recent ownership transfer date, potentially after an arms-length sale

fields.name: unmodified_owner
fields.description: Owner name before standardization or other modifications

fields.name: mailadd
fields.description: Address receiving tax and assessor communications; may differ from parcel address

fields.name: mail_urbanization
fields.description: Mailing address urbanizacion for Puerto Rico

fields.name: original_mailing_address
fields.description: County mailing address fields as a JSON string or legacy semicolon-separated text

fields.name: address
fields.description: Parcel situs or site address; may be absent

fields.name: original_address
fields.description: County parcel address fields as a JSON string or legacy semicolon-separated text

fields.name: city
fields.description: US Census county subdivision; use scity for the site address city

fields.name: urbanization
fields.description: Parcel urbanizacion postal field commonly used in Puerto Rico

fields.name: ll_address_count
fields.description: Regrid-calculated total primary and secondary addresses on the parcel

fields.name: location_name
fields.description: Name commonly associated with the parcel

fields.name: address_source
fields.description: Primary address source; county is the default when none is listed

fields.name: lat
fields.description: On-parcel centroid latitude in decimal coordinates

fields.name: lon
fields.description: On-parcel centroid longitude in decimal coordinates

fields.name: fema_nri_risk_rating
fields.description: FEMA National Risk Index relative natural-hazard risk rating at Census tract level

fields.name: qoz_tract
fields.description: Qualified Opportunity Zone tract number using December 2018 tract definitions

fields.name: census_zcta
fields.description: Census ZIP Code Tabulation Area containing the parcel center

fields.name: ll_last_refresh
fields.description: Last date Regrid refreshed county data

fields.name: sourceurl
fields.description: County-provided link to the parcel record

fields.name: recrdareano
fields.description: Assessor-provided habitable or taxable structure area in square feet

fields.name: area_building
fields.description: Assessor-defined total structure area in square feet, potentially including common areas

fields.name: area_building_definition
fields.description: Definition of the area reported by area_building

fields.name: ll_bldg_footprint_sqft
fields.description: Regrid-calculated total building footprint square feet

fields.name: cdl_raw
fields.description: Cropland pixel-class value and percentage pairs encoded as text

fields.name: cdl_majority_category
fields.description: Human-readable land-cover category most common on the parcel

fields.name: cdl_majority_percent
fields.description: Percentage of pixels in the majority cropland category

fields.name: cdl_date
fields.description: Year of the Cropland Data Layer dataset

fields.name: plss_township
fields.description: Public Land Survey System township reference

fields.name: plss_section
fields.description: Public Land Survey System section reference

fields.name: plss_range
fields.description: Public Land Survey System range reference

fields.name: path
fields.description: Human-readable parcel identifier; not guaranteed stable between updates

fields.name: ll_stable_id
fields.description: Refresh matching status; nonempty values indicate a parcel matched to prior data

fields.name: ll_uuid
fields.description: Stable v4 UUID identifying a parcel across county refreshes

fields.name: ll_stack_uuid
fields.description: Arbitrary member UUID identifying a group of identical parcel geometries

fields.name: ll_row_parcel
fields.description: Trait indicating a likely right-of-way parcel

fields.name: ll_updated_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the last row modification

fields.name: precisely_id
fields.description: Precisely point-addressable-location identifier shared by alias addresses

fields.name: usps_vacancy_date
fields.description: Date the USPS vacancy indicator was collected

fields.name: padus_public_access
fields.description: USGS Protected Areas Database public access designation

fields.name: lbcs_activity_desc
fields.description: Description of the LBCS activity code

fields.name: lbcs_function
fields.description: LBCS economic function or establishment type code

fields.name: lbcs_function_desc
fields.description: Description of the LBCS economic function code

fields.name: lbcs_structure
fields.description: LBCS structure or building type code

fields.name: lbcs_structure_desc
fields.description: Description of the LBCS structure code

fields.name: lbcs_site
fields.description: LBCS site code describing what is on the land

fields.name: lbcs_site_desc
fields.description: Description of the LBCS site code

fields.name: lbcs_ownership_desc
fields.description: Description of the LBCS ownership structure code

fields.name: housing_affordability_index
fields.description: Blockgroup housing affordability index; 100 denotes median-income affordability threshold

fields.name: population_density
fields.description: Blockgroup estimated population per square mile

fields.name: population_growth_past_5_years
fields.description: Blockgroup population compound annual growth over the previous five years

fields.name: population_growth_next_5_years
fields.description: Blockgroup five-year population compound annual growth forecast

fields.name: housing_growth_past_5_years
fields.description: Blockgroup housing-unit compound annual growth over the previous five years

fields.name: housing_growth_next_5_years
fields.description: Blockgroup five-year housing-unit compound annual growth forecast

fields.name: household_income_growth_next_5_years
fields.description: Blockgroup five-year median household income compound annual growth forecast

fields.name: median_household_income
fields.description: Blockgroup median household income estimate; upper interval represented by 200001

fields.name: transmission_line_distance
fields.description: Distance from parcel boundary to nearest HIFLD high-voltage transmission line

fields.name: roughness_rating
fields.description: Parcel elevation variability calculated from a digital elevation model

fields.name: highest_parcel_elevation
fields.description: Highest terrain elevation in meters intersecting the parcel

fields.name: lowest_parcel_elevation
fields.description: Lowest terrain elevation in meters intersecting the parcel
